changelog:
Initial public release of Agent Browser.

- Fast Rust-based CLI tool for headless browser automation, with Node.js fallback.
- Enables AI agents and scripts to navigate, interact, and extract data from web pages.
- Supports structured commands for navigation, clicking, typing, snapshotting, and more.
- Offers advanced features: screenshots, video recording, PDF export, network interception, and session state management.
- Includes semantic element locators and rich support for cookies, storage, tabs, windows, and frames.
